verdict.rationale: 2FAS Auth generates TOTP codes on iOS and Android (2fas-docs-37) and describes itself as local-first by design with no public API (2fas-probe-1, 2fas-probe-rt-1). It is free with no tiers and no telemetry (2fas-probe-rt-2), and cloud sync is an opt-in you choose to enable (2fas-docs-23). The companion browser extension needs no login (2fas-docs-27), though it relies on pairing with the phone. missing for 10: an explicit statement that 2FAS Auth codes generate with no network connection, an explicit no-account/no-registration statement for 2FAS Auth itself (the 'no registration' claim in 2fas-docs-28 covers 2FAS Pass), and independent or hands-on confirmation of offline operation.
